select deadline1.* from(select @rn := @rn +1 num, deadline.* from( SELECT A.BUSI_DATE busiDate, A.MARKET_CODE marketCode, A.IS_HOLIDAY isHoliday, A.STATUS status, A.DEPT_CODE deptCode FROM CHB_MKT_HOLIDAY A
A.BUSI_DATE < str_to_date(#{holidayDate},'%y-%M-%d';)
A.BUSI_DATE > str_to_date(#{holidayDate},'%y-%M-%d';)
AND A.MARKET_CODE = #{marketCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.STATUS = 'E' AND A.IS_HOLIDAY = '1'
order by A.BUSI_DATE desc
order by A.BUSI_DATE asc
)deadline, (SELECT @rn := 0) b )deadline1 where deadline1.num = #{days,jdbcType=INTEGER}

select deadline1.* from(select @rn := @rn +1 num, deadline.* from( SELECT A.BUSI_DATE busiDate, A.MARKET_CODE marketCode, A.IS_HOLIDAY isHoliday, A.STATUS status, A.DEPT_CODE deptCode FROM CHB_MKT_HOLIDAY A
A.BUSI_DATE <= str_to_date(#{holidayDate},'%y-%M-%d';)
A.BUSI_DATE >= str_to_date(#{holidayDate},'%y-%M-%d';)
AND A.MARKET_CODE = #{marketCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.STATUS = 'E' AND A.IS_HOLIDAY = '1'
order by A.BUSI_DATE desc
order by A.BUSI_DATE asc
)deadline , (SELECT @rn := 0) b )deadline1 where deadline1.num = 1
